metadata.required_game_version: Official v1.3 build (non-SafeDisc release or optical disc; stock SafeDisc stxt* EXEs are blocked by Windows 10/11 secdrv.sys)
metadata.notes: EU/PAL 2005 retail release (`speed.exe` SHA-256 c60f1d0f...34d35) and ThirteenAG WidescreenFix archive are live-verified. US/Black Edition template hashes remain marked `unverified_template`.

known_issues.summary: SafeDisc 4.x kernel driver (secdrv.sys) is disabled on Windows 10 and Windows 11
known_issues.details: Original 2005 retail discs rely on SafeDisc DRM whose kernel driver is permanently blocked on modern Windows releases for security reasons, causing speed.exe to silently exit on startup.
known_issues.user_action_required: Ensure you have installed EA's official v1.3 game patch and that your legally owned installation is a non-SafeDisc release (this launcher never distributes or applies DRM bypasses).

known_issues.summary: Missing native 16:9/21:9 resolutions, stretched HUD, and cropped vertical FOV
known_issues.details: Stock v1.3 caps resolutions at 4:3/5:4 modes and stretches 2D HUD gauges horizontally on modern monitors. ThirteenAG's open-source Widescreen Fix dynamically patches resolution, HUD aspect constraints, and FMV scaling.

known_issues.summary: Vanishing or blocky dynamic shadows under bridges and on modern GPU drivers
known_issues.details: Widescreen Fix enables ShadowsFix and 4096-px dynamic shadow maps; an optional dgVoodoo 2 D3D9 wrapper can further stabilize rendering on modern Intel/AMD/NVIDIA drivers.

known_issues.summary: Frame pacing stutter on high-core-count modern CPUs
known_issues.details: Capping logical CPU affinity to 4 cores at launch and disabling Windows fullscreen optimizations stabilizes frame pacing without altering game files.

known_issues.summary: Modern Xbox/XInput controllers lack split triggers and proper deadzones under legacy DirectInput
known_issues.details: ThirteenAG WidescreenFix includes built-in, post-unpack XInput controller support (ImproveGamepadSupport = 1, analog stick deadzones, and right-stick camera) with Xbox/PlayStation button prompts across all speed.exe builds without breaking the in-game Controls menu.

known_issues.summary: Default save location writes inside the user Documents directory
known_issues.details: Redirects profile and career saves into the per-game portable `.ogsc_sandbox/saves` directory via Widescreen Fix's CustomUserFilesDirectoryInGameDir setting.

fixes.title: ThirteenAG Widescreen Fix + 4K Shadows
fixes.description: Downloads Ultimate ASI Loader (dinput8.dll) and NFSMostWanted.WidescreenFix.asi, configures your native desktop resolution, locks HUD/FOV aspect ratio, and enables 4096px dynamic shadows in scripts/NFSMostWanted.WidescreenFix.ini.

steps.name: Install ThirteenAG Widescreen Fix
steps.description: Downloads the verified open-source Widescreen Fix archive (Ultimate ASI Loader `dinput8.dll` + `NFSMostWanted.WidescreenFix.asi`).

steps.name: Configure Native Resolution & Shadows
steps.description: Sets desktop width/height, HUD aspect ratio lock, and 4096px dynamic shadows in `scripts/NFSMostWanted.WidescreenFix.ini`.

fixes.title: Portable Save Sandbox (.ogsc_sandbox/saves)
fixes.description: Creates `.ogsc_sandbox/saves` inside the game folder, copies existing Documents saves non-destructively, and configures CustomUserFilesDirectoryInGameDir.

steps.name: Initialize Portable Save Sandbox
steps.description: Creates `.ogsc_sandbox/saves` inside the game directory and optionally copies existing saves without deleting originals.

fixes.title: Windows 10/11 DPI, Presentation & 4-Core Affinity
fixes.description: Writes per-user HKCU AppCompatFlags (HIGHDPIAWARE + DISABLEDXMAXIMIZEDWINDOWEDMODE) for speed.exe and caps runtime CPU affinity to 4 cores to eliminate frame-pacing stutter.

steps.name: Apply Windows High-DPI & Presentation Flags
steps.description: Applies non-destructive per-user HKCU AppCompat flags disabling DPI virtualization and fullscreen presentation interference.

steps.name: Cap CPU Affinity to 4 Logical Cores
steps.description: Applies a runtime processor affinity mask on launch to eliminate frame-pacing stutter on high-core CPUs.

fixes.title: dgVoodoo 2 Direct3D 9 -> Direct3D 11 Wrapper
fixes.description: Deploys dgVoodoo 2 x86 `d3d9.dll` and `dgVoodoo.conf` into the game root. Recommended if you experience alt-tab crashes or GPU driver-specific shadow glitches.

steps.name: Deploy dgVoodoo 2 D3D9 Wrapper
steps.description: Translates Direct3D 9 to Direct3D 11 for systems experiencing driver-specific shadow or alt-tab glitches.

fixes.title: Modern Controller Support (XInput Gamepad & Xbox Icons)
fixes.description: Enables ThirteenAG WidescreenFix's built-in XInput controller support, Xbox button prompts, 10% analog stick deadzones, and right-stick camera in scripts/NFSMostWanted.WidescreenFix.ini without injecting conflicting controller hooks.

steps.name: Ensure WidescreenFix XInput Runtime
steps.description: Ensures ThirteenAG's verified Ultimate ASI Loader (dinput8.dll) and NFSMostWanted.WidescreenFix.asi are present without overwriting existing INI settings.

steps.name: Configure XInput Gamepad, Deadzones & Right-Stick Camera
steps.description: Enables ImproveGamepadSupport = 1 (Xbox icons), 10% stick deadzones, and right-stick camera control in scripts/NFSMostWanted.WidescreenFix.ini.
